78' 3 - 2 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Joe Scally is pounced on by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach). His close-range header flashes past Oliver Baumann and into the left of the goal. 3:2.

69' Wow, what an escape. Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
67' The linesman signals that Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

66' 3 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top left corner. Moritz Nicolas just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 3:1.
65' OFF THE POST! Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
64' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

63' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Hoffenheim will have a corner.
62' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
61' The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
60' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom left corner is far too weak and Oliver Baumann makes a simple save.
58' 2 - 1 Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
56' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

55' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Hoffenheim win a corner.
52' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) lines up the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but he produces a poor shot that goes high over the bar. The ball could have snow on it when it returns!
52' Hoffenheim get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.

51' That's unlucky! Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
50' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Moritz Nicolas.
50' What a chance that is! Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Soren Storks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

42' B. Monchengladbach concede a free kick following a bad challenge.

40' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The B. Monchengladbach players aren’t happy.
39' 1 - 1 GOAL! Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) runs onto a pass from Alassane Plea after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 1:1.
38' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:4.

33' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
32' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the right post with his header. A stroke of luck for the goalkeeper!
30' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
30' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes a short corner kick.
28' 64:36 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
26' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

26' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.

25' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
25' A quickly taken corner by B. Monchengladbach.
23' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

18' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Hoffenheim.

18' Moritz Nicolas pulls off a great save to deny Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the top left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
16' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) tries to find Wout Weghorst, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
15' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
14' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
13' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Moritz Nicolas, who smothers the ball.
11' Soren Storks couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) and blew his whistle.
9' The shot by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Oliver Baumann.
9' The ball breaks to Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked.
8' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
8' Hoffenheim control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
